title: Joseph McMoneagle awarded the Legion of Merit for remote viewing
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Joseph McMoneagle awarded the Legion of Merit for remote viewing, about 1970s-1990s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: you have guys like Joseph mcmonagle who have won the Legion of Merit for over 200 instances

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Joseph McMoneagle, a man who worked as a remote viewer for the US government, meaning someone trained to describe distant places or things using only the mind, won the Legion of Merit, a US military award. According to Michels, the award was for more than 200 instances of this work between the 1970s and 1990s, which he offers as a sign the government took the ability seriously.
